1927, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 37 Cont.
Febr. 5th, 1928. Mrs. Anderson's daughter to be baptized this p.m. says mother is ablle to be up and around and manage, etc.
June 13th Divorce Frustrated. John T. Belanger Sr. 50, (14033 North Lawn) a- way from wife and Fam. 8 years last Feb. Enrolled 1926 then about to be married is enrolled by faithful wife. To-day she reports him as wanting to come to Monastery ..... June 20th sends $10.00 for poor Missions - double enrollment.
Page 38
June 19th Pneumonia - & Spinalmenigitis. Francis Jos. Milton 33 of 15124 Men- dotte Ave. hopelessly ill of pneumonia is enrolled (Wednesday) June 15th. Friday night 17th is given 48 to live - having spinal-meni- gitis. Sunday 19th 11.30 A.M. reported "Doctors Hopeless."
.
July 6th Samuel Golunlo 40, (2107 Jos. Compo) not to Holy Communion since Married in 1923 brought to Monastery last Sunday July 3, A.M. not able to speak: All he could do was cry and make signs. Wife and friends in consternation: They enroll him for 2 years promising all to go to weekly communion till 1928. To-day they all return praising God - Samuel has relief telling that on Monday he was able to talk. He went to confession and Holy Com. Tuesday and now is all smiles. --- Deo Gr.
July 7th Edward Murph 13 of 1041 E. 47th St. Chicago now blind since one year old: comes To-day with Aunt (Mrs. Nora Dwyer) and is enrolled per- petually. Edward took 4th prize in class of 74 recently Now about to enter High School. He hopes, God willing if able to see to be a priest.
July 7th Joseph Ronde ( ) after four yrs stomach trouble, once more in perfect health. He was enrolled first just before Christmas (last) after doctor had vainly sought cause of such trouble - and after X-ray examinations had twelve times proved
July 6th Cancer! !! Divina Clairmont 57, Ford City, Ont. found to be hopeless- ly cancerous June 29 - liver a simple mass of cancers so that doctors apalled sew her up in despair.
July 13 To-day reported as positively improving - Husband who had not been to confession in 28 years goes to sacraments promising weekly Communion for year. July 19 enrolled again $5.00
